prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right partner depends on your goals (brand vs performance), budget, industry, data maturity, and whether you need AI for creative, media buying, customer personalization, or martech integrations. That said, here are reputable LA-area agencies and firms to consider, grouped by strength:

AI-first / programmatic media
- Cognitiv — built on deep learning for programmatic media optimization; good if you want machine-driven media buying at scale.
- 3Q Digital (Santa Monica) — performance-focused agency with strong data science and programmatic capabilities.

Enterprise creative + product + AI
- R/GA (LA office) — large agency that combines creative, data and engineering; good for brand work that needs product or AI integrations.
- AKQA (LA) — experience design + tech + personalization for brand and product experiences.

Data-driven personalization & CRM
- Merkle (part of Dentsu) — customer-first enterprise agency focused on data, CRM, personalization, and analytics.
- Tinuiti — performance marketing with emphasis on retail/commerce, data, and automation.

Performance & mid-market paid media
- Wpromote (LA/El Segundo) — performance marketing that layers AI/automation across paid media and growth programs.
- Brainlabs / 3rd-party specialists — (Brainlabs has U.S. presence) known for experimentation, automation and paid performance.

Consulting / systems integration (if you need martech + AI at enterprise scale)
- Accenture Song / Deloitte Digital / Cognizant Interactive — good when you need martech architecture, AI model ops, and cross-channel integrations at scale.

How to pick the “best” for you
- Define the objective: brand awareness, acquisition CPA, LTV, personalization, creative automation, etc.
- Check case studies in your industry and for the specific capability you need (e.g., programmatic, personalization, creative optimization).
- Ask about tech stack and IP: proprietary models, third‑party AI, integrations with your CDP/CRM, data access.
- Request metrics and a small pilot: expected lift, measurement approach, time to value.
- Verify data/privacy practices and compliance (PII handling, consent, CCPA/CPRA if applicable).
- Meet the team who will do the work (data scientists, engineers, strategists, creatives).

If you tell me your company size, budget, industry, and primary objective (brand, performance, personalization, martech integration), I can narrow this to 2–3 agencies in LA and suggest specific questions and RFP criteria.
